name: Pung
description: Pung, the open instrument platform: open instruments, audio effects and MIDI generators on Push 3 as devices in Live, in Push's browser and device view, each with a designed interface on the Push screen. It hosts instruments in the Open Instrument format (modules written for Schwung, which began on Ableton Move, are accepted as they are), on Push Hack's Live device layer (core/livedevice). Needs Push Manager's VST3 scan switched on.
author: rgeissen
